# Sync, Security and Configuration Checklist: Engagement Layer (board ↔ platform)

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review of board–platform consistency, security and decision
rights, and configurability, for the reviewer at Gate 2 (plan review)
**Created**: 2026-11-20
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md), [plan.md](../plan.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Consistency: exactly once and ordering

- [ ] CHK001 - Is the idempotency key for a board change defined unambiguously, given that an update on the other side of a link keeps the item's revision (so "work item id and revision" in FR-012 and the spec's text differ from the plan's "work item id and update id")? [Conflict, Spec §FR-012, research R-04]
- [ ] CHK002 - Is "processed in revision order per item" defined for changes to different items in the same poll, including when one item's request depends on another (a decision on a run item and an edit to its Epic in one interval)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK003 - Are the requirements explicit that the watermark advances only after every item of a poll has been processed, and what happens to the watermark when one item's processing fails? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010, research R-04]
- [ ] CHK004 - Is the behaviour defined for the first start of the sync on a board with existing history (old decisions replayed against current platform state: refused as stale, and would they be reverted or left alone)? [Gap, research R-04]
- [ ] CHK005 - Is crash recovery between "claimed" and "outcome" specified so that a command is neither lost nor applied twice, and is the source marker it relies on a requirement rather than only a plan detail? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012, §FR-024, research R-07]
- [ ] CHK006 - Is "read as they stand in the same revision" (FR-015) consistent with the edge case where the comment is saved in a later revision than the decision? [Consistency, Spec §FR-015, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK007 - Do the requirements state how two decisions saved on one item between polls are judged (the second against the run as the first left it), including when the first was refused and reverted? [Coverage, Edge Cases]

## Consistency: reverts, projection and reconciliation

- [ ] CHK008 - Is the value a revert restores defined precisely ("the value before this update"), and what happens when a later update by another person changed the same field before the revert is written? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016, contracts/inbound-rules.md §5]
- [ ] CHK009 - Is it specified that the projector never clears a person's decision, input or answer before inbound sync has read it, as a requirement in the spec and not only in research R-09? [Gap, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK010 - Are the platform-written fields listed for every item kind, and is it consistent across FR-006, FR-017 and the mapping contract which fields a person may change? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, §FR-017, contracts/tracker-mapping.md]
- [ ] CHK011 - Is the interaction between a running reconciliation and concurrent inbound changes or projections defined (who wins, can reconciliation revert a person's unread request)? [Gap, Spec §FR-020]
- [ ] CHK012 - Is the FR-007 change at Gate 2 (own delivery state with the outbox's retry and dead-letter rule, instead of the outbox itself) reflected consistently in the spec's user stories (US1 scenario 6) and success criteria? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, plan Complexity Tracking]
- [ ] CHK013 - Is "the two never disagree once a poll and the outbox have caught up" (FR-027) measurable, with a defined bound or test condition? [Measurability, Spec §FR-027]
- [ ] CHK014 - Are requirements defined for an item deleted or moved to Removed by a person while it is linked (recreate on reconciliation only, or on the next projection too)? [Coverage, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK015 - Is the order of projection relative to a refusal's revert defined, so the board never briefly shows a refused decision as accepted? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016]

## Outages and recovery

- [ ] CHK016 - Are the dead-letter and requeue requirements for board projection complete (who sees them, what requeue does, whether a requeued use case is recomputed from current state)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, contracts/api-cli-settings.md]
- [ ] CHK017 - Is the behaviour defined when the board is unreachable at sync start (mapping check cannot run): retry, health state, and whether the platform starts normally? [Coverage, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK018 - Is SC-005's "10 minutes" outage consistent with the outbox retry schedule (dead letter after about 21 minutes of failures), and is the expected state after a longer outage specified? [Consistency, Spec §SC-005, §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK019 - Are requirements defined for a revoked or wrong service-account token mid-run (sync stops, health, recovery once fixed)? [Completeness, Edge Cases]

## Security and decision rights

- [ ] CHK020 - Is the trust placed in the board's attribution of a change (the board's "changed by") stated as an assumption, with who can impersonate whom on the board (a board administrator) and why that is acceptable for Option A? [Assumption, Gap]
- [ ] CHK021 - Is it specified that the unmapped-user refusal happens before any rule that could reveal platform state (a reason that names roles or run state to an unknown user)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013, §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK022 - Are the uniqueness and case rules of `board_identity`, and the refusal when two accounts claim one identity, part of the requirements? [Completeness, Spec Assumptions, research R-11]
- [ ] CHK023 - Is it a requirement that the service account cannot also be a person's mapped identity, so platform writes are never mistaken for a person's request (and vice versa)? [Gap, research R-11]
- [ ] CHK024 - Is separation of duties for waivers (proposer ≠ approver) stated for board-made proposals and board-made approvals in every combination (board/inbox)? [Coverage, Spec §US5]
- [ ] CHK025 - Are the rights to register a use case from the board defined (any mapped person, or only those who may submit in the inbox)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-018, §US3]
- [ ] CHK026 - Is the role required for reconciliation and requeue named consistently (the spec says "CoE role"; the plan uses the dead-letter role setting)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-019, research R-08]
- [ ] CHK027 - Are the token's storage, rotation and exposure rules stated (settings only, never logged, never in the board, health output free of it)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK028 - Does FR-023 cover reason texts that could echo a person's input (an unknown root cause value quoted in a refusal) in logs and traces, not only in board comments? [Coverage, Spec §FR-023]
- [ ] CHK029 - Are requirements defined for what a refusal comment may disclose (for example the roles that may decide) to the person who saw it on the board? [Gap, Spec §FR-016]

## Configurability

- [ ] CHK030 - Is the list of "tracker-specific values" the code scan forbids defined (types, states, fields, decision values, labels, area), and is its source the mapping file? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, contracts/tracker-mapping.md]
- [ ] CHK031 - Do the mapping completeness rules cover every decision input every terminal's form can require, including emitted values with their types? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, contracts/tracker-mapping.md V-35, V-36]
- [ ] CHK032 - Is the effect of changing the mapping while items exist defined (renamed column or field: reconciliation repairs; old decision values: refused)? [Gap, research R-12]
- [ ] CHK033 - Is the decision not to pin the mapping per use case recorded as a requirement-level decision, consistent with constitution I (pinned specs)? [Consistency, research R-12]
- [ ] CHK034 - Are the comment-line labels and their precedence over fields specified clearly enough that two readers would parse the same comment the same way (case, spacing, repeated labels, multi-line values)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-028]

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] CHK035 - Are SC-001 and SC-002's percentiles measurable in the test environment as planned (on the fake board with a 10-second interval) and on the demo host, and is the difference stated? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK036 - Is SC-007's "identical in kind" ledger defined (which records, fields and attributions must match an inbox-driven run)? [Clarity, Spec §SC-007]

## Notes

- Items reference the spec (`Spec §…`), the plan's research (`research R-…`) and the contracts.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist state but does not modify markers.
